_about: What the engine writes about, one article a week, in this order. Each topic is a founder's real question; the pains come from the Halo research (docs/landing-page/2026-10-14-halo-research/README.md, 14 Oct 2026) and the live service pages. Add or reorder topics here; a written topic is never repeated: the state file remembers it, and once drafts go to WordPress the fixed 'slug' (the post's web address) is checked there too. 'tier' is the place ladder (local -> state -> national, docs/seo-aeo/README.md); problem questions are national from week 1.
